quarterly_data.quarter: Power Integrations press release: Power Integrations and Ideal Power Collaborate on (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power Integrations and Ideal Power announced a collaboration on a solid-state circuit breaker (SSCB) for 800 VDC AI data centers, combining Power Integrations' 1700 V InnoMux-2 power conversion ICs (1700 V PowiGaN technology; converts 800 V into isolated power for gate-drive, control, sensing and auxiliary circuitry) with Ideal Power's B-TRAN bidirectional switches in a self-powered SSCB. The companies have demonstrated a working prototype and are working on a reference design; no supply agreement or availability date was stated.
